test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about South Asian Regional Standards Organization (SARSO) is/are correct?

1) SARSO began functioning in 1985 to regulate tariffs and pricing in SAARC.

2) SARSO aims to harmonize standards and conformity assessments to boost intra-SAARC trade and global access.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **South Asian Regional Standards Organization (SARSO)** was established in **2011**, under the aegis of SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation).
 
• The primary purpose of SARSO is to **harmonize standards** and develop conformity assessments for the member countries of SAARC to facilitate **intra-regional trade**.
 
• It aims to reduce technical barriers to trade (TBT) and **enhance global market access** for products originating from SAARC nations. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
 
• Statement 1 is incorrect because SARSO did not begin functioning in **1985**, and it is not associated with regulating tariffs or pricing.
 
• SARSO’s headquarters is located in **Dhaka, Bangladesh**, and its activities focus on **standardization** rather than tariff regulations. *Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.*
